subject.title: fix(proxy): add error handler on upstream response stream

question: Should this conflicting external PR be refreshed or maintainer-ported onto current main before merge?
rationale: The fix is useful and source-backed, but GitHub reports a conflicting branch in files that now contain newer proxy capture behavior, so a human should choose the refresh path before merge.

options.title: Port onto current main
options.body: Refresh or maintainer-port the upstreamRes error handler and test while preserving current body-preview capture helpers and assertions.

options.title: Wait for author refresh
options.body: Leave the PR open for the contributor to rebase and update the test against current main before another review.

recommendation.title: Port onto current main
recommendation.body: Refresh or maintainer-port the upstreamRes error handler and test while preserving current body-preview capture helpers and assertions.
